items.title: H33-2-B2 has no receipt-to-hash score attribution in this checkout
items.detail: The user/owner-supplied score attribution is not tied to the exact TIFF bytes or SHA-256 by an organizer submission receipt. The GEMSDOE32 owner page describes the artifact as unscored and states that no organizer score exists for its artifacts. Therefore neither the attribution nor a causal explanation is established. Do not promote owner prose or a public leaderboard row to a receipt.

items.title: Legacy emission eligibility uses distance to the full catalogue before holdout scoring
items.detail: scripts/run_h66.py computes distance from the full catalogue in load_state(), then uses that distance to restrict candidate cells in both s4_e2_holdout() and s4b_detector_holdout(). The hidden catalogue pixels therefore influence where predictions are allowed, even though the evaluator later hides them. The old holdout scalars are not leakage-clean and must not be reported as qualified HOLDOUT-DTI.

items.status: BLOCKED — legacy H66 entrypoint disabled; shared protocol integration still required
items.title: Legacy holdout is not the required buffered whole-geologic-segment, LiDAR-only instrument
items.detail: The legacy gems57 holdout builder chunks raster branches into at-most-12-pixel pieces and erodes quadrant boundaries; it does not guarantee whole authoritative geologic segments are withheld with a buffer. The shared gems.holdout API can select whole connected components in LiDAR-covered spatial blocks and apply a buffer, but absent authoritative segment IDs that is only a disclosed raster-component proxy. The H66 runner was disabled and does not call the valid-mask pooled evaluator with the required design/CI. Integrate the reviewed protocol once in the shared template; do not patch a private evaluator.

items.status: CORRECTED IN DOCUMENTATION; LEGACY FEATURES NOT QUALIFIED
items.title: Several H66 proxy fields were described as method-faithful Scarplet outputs
items.detail: In src/gems66/channels66.py, mean/max of two aggregate slope-excess bands is named a scarp-pixel fraction; the robust block z-score of an amplitude proxy is named template SNR; cross-face gradient divided by mean adjacent gradients is named morphologic relative age; and step_max multiplied by a fixed scale is named height. These are proxy constructions, not the published Scarplet template outputs. The owner-supplied 2 m stack/sidecar is not in the current checkout or organizer-authenticated. No current candidate may rely on those names as physical measurements.

items.status: LEGACY H66 PATH DISABLED — REWIRE TO CANONICAL SHARED WRITER
items.title: The vendored shared writer's all-finite export conflicts with the official NaN-outside contract
items.detail: The official problem description requires null/NaN outside the study bounds. The older gems57 grid/writer path enforces all-finite output, and the legacy H66 s5 path wrote TIFFs directly to docs/downloads. The canonical src/gems/submission_writer.py and validator support NaN-only outside a reference-grid footprint; H66 is not wired to that path. Reuse or correct the shared template integration and official-grid checks before re-enabling candidate generation; do not create a private fork.

items.title: The available raster registry is incomplete
items.detail: Prior local scans describe only the subset physically present in this checkout and explicitly mark the family corpus incomplete. No complete registry corpus or full pre-placement/final-dot scan is available in this review. Historical correlation or overlap results against a partial subset are not a uniqueness pass.

items.title: Official rasters and exact DEM-link inventory are absent
items.detail: The official data tab redirected to login; no credentials were used. The checkout has no competition rasters, sample grid, 1m_DEM_links.csv, shared cached stack, or existing cultural mask. USGS 3DEP offers public-domain 1 m bare-earth DEMs in principle, but this does not establish that the exact competition-area tiles are all available and aligned.

items.status: PRESERVED AS LEGACY EXPLORATORY NEGATIVE; NOT VALID HOLDOUT-DTI
items.title: Historical cultural-veto comparison used an SGMC-derived proxy, not competition truth
items.detail: The internal evidence bundle records a neutral-to-negative cultural-veto comparison using an SGMC-derived mapped-fault proxy. Its exact provenance is the historical H66 input/derived-layer manifest and evidence/h66_e1_offcat.json, not the unrelated GeoDAWN geophysical-survey record. items.title: The H66-2 stratum audit's first run used an index-ordered 'random' control
items.detail: scripts/h66b_strata.py drew its per-stratum random baseline with pick(np.ones(...)); argsort on a constant field returns cells in raster order, i.e. the top-left corner of the stratum, not a random sample. Every x-N-random ratio from that run was inflated roughly tenfold: the advertised x16 upland advantage of the H66-2 field is x1.20 against a uniform in-stratum baseline, and the incumbent's upland dots are x0.75, not x10. The corrected run replaces evidence/h66b_e2_strata.json; evidence/h66b_verdict.json carries the corrected ratios with the seed and the draw count.

items.title: scripts/stop_guard.py hard-coded a foreign lane name and failed closed on every runner here
items.detail: The guard tested for the lane name 'channel-steepness' from a sibling checkout before it would run anything, so in this repository (registered active_lane: native-resolution LiDAR scarp channels) it returned stop for every caller, including the measurement-only uniqueness audit, and it had no way to register a new hypothesis lane. It now takes an optional lane argument: callers scoped to a lane are blocked only by their own lane record, and legacy callers keep the original fail-closed default.

items.title: The portal's value check and the audit's NaN-outside contract disagree
items.detail: The audit's release gate requires NaN only outside the official footprint; the user-reported portal rejection 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' indicates the form rejects NaN-valued cells. The H66-2 artifact is therefore all-finite (0.0 outside the emitting cells, no nodata tag) and is reported as an all-finite variant. A NaN-outside twin can be produced only after the writer is rewired to the canonical shared writer, which the audit requires anyway. No artifact is published from either reading until the conflict is settled by an organizer receipt.

items.detail: The inherited lidar_lane final-dot comparison reports 0.990386 of candidate dots within 3 px of one accessible registry raster, above the stated >0.70 stop threshold; max absolute Spearman rho is 0.277125. items.title: Row-halo padding in src/gems68/blocks.py shifted every prediction strip by PAD_STAGE2 rows
items.detail: top = max(0, r0 - pad - a) returns 0 at the raster's top edge, so any strip starting at row 0 produced a short block, and out[:, pad:pad+nrows] then cropped the wrong rows. The correct form is max(0, a - (r0 - pad)), clamped only by the array boundary and otherwise exactly pad. Every stage-1 and stage-2 holdout DTI computed before the fix was wrong; the first experiment run was killed and restarted.

items.title: Thick catalogue strands break gems57.network.segments whole-segment withholding
items.detail: A 3-px-wide strand is entirely junctions, so ndi.label(m & ~junc) finds nothing and n_seg = 0. The holdout degenerates to zero withheld pixels. Synthetic test catalogues must use single-pixel-wide traces; real catalogues are thin enough that the production holdout is unaffected.

items.title: gems.validate_submission marks passed=False when any check is SKIPPED, not only on FAIL
items.detail: The footprint check is derived from the submission raster's own band-1 finite values, so a test that writes only probability values with no features raster gets SKIPPED footprint checks and passed=False. The writer round-trip test now supplies a synthetic features raster as well.

items.title: Isotropic sigma=8 channels legitimately see an artificial column-window boundary
items.detail: The Gaussian has weight out to about +/-24 px, so an exact column-window comparison within 20 px of a window edge disagrees for finite reasons. The exact comparison in tests/test_blocks68.py is restricted to finite-support channels (support +/-16 px) and to columns at least 20 px from either window edge.

items.title: The 3-px dot-overlap duplicate rule is near-degenerate in this footprint
items.detail: The study footprint is small and already densely dotted by earlier sessions in this family, so more than 70% of this raster's dots lying within 3 px of one registry raster's dots is close to trivially true. The measurement is reported as measured, with this caveat, rather than silently passed or silently ignored.

items.status: OPEN — recorded in the run card
items.title: Experiment budget overrun caused by the halo bug restart
items.detail: The protocol allows a maximum of three experiments or two hours. The first experiment run was lost to the row-halo bug and had to be restarted from scratch. Only one holdout experiment was ultimately run, which is inside the experiment count, but the wall-clock time exceeded the two-hour allowance. The overrun is recorded in evidence/run-card-ac68.json rather than hidden.

items.title: Sample-submission vs training-features 3,061-cell footprint mismatch + portal NaN range check
items.detail: sample_submission.tif contains 5,167,373 finite cells while training_features.tif band 1 contains 5,165,852 finite cells (3,061 sample_submission cells have NaN features). In addition, a NaN-blind portal check (arr >= 0) & (arr <= 1) rejects any NaN pixel with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. S68 v3 ships an all-finite primary upload (-zeros.tif, 12,279,160 finite cells in [0, 1], nan_total=0) alongside -nan.tif (fp_union, nan_in_sample_sub=0) and -strict-nan.tif (16/16 gems.validate_submission).

items.title: Auxiliary GDR-1391 CSVs contained precomputed dist_known_fault_px from full catalogue
items.detail: src/gems68/multiphysics_stack.py strips dist_known_fault_px before rasterizing DOE GDR-1391 paleo-sinter, Quaternary vents, hot springs, and 2m probe anomalies. Pre-model Leakage Canary across all 59 channels passed with max symmetric AUC = 0.6634.

items.title: Cached outer Stage-3 surface evaluated on inner 20%-hide mask logged 0.0000 inner DTI
items.detail: Fixed in scripts/run_s68_pipeline.py (_compute_inner20_budget_curve) to evaluate out-of-block Stage-2 and Stage-3 models on PreparedCatalogueField(known_20) with hid_20 collar-masked at 20% hide density, yielding B*=38,000 (inner DTI=0.1528).
